prompt_digest: Design a highly modular, production-ready Python component using a pretrained ResNet50 (without classification head) to process a batch of grayscale or RGB chest X-ray images and output 2048-dimensional embeddings for an LSTM-based decoder.  Handle preprocessing, feature extraction, and dimension projection. Ensure device compatibility (CPU/GPU), batching, and extensibility for other CNN backbones. Provide backend code with clean interfaces, detailed docstrings, and industry-quality structure.

It handles device placement and offers optional projection. Response 2 is also correct in its core functionality but lacks features.
